svg.title: Chase Struse · Solar Ram Studios
svg.desc: Animated banner: Chase Struse, Senior Software Engineer at Solar Ram Studios, forging the Solar Forge suite of local-first apps. A glowing sun is orbited by Solar Forge apps while a terminal runs a local LLM with zero bytes sent to the cloud.

g.text: SOLAR RAM STUDIOS · IDEAS BUILT TO SHINE
Forging Solar Forge: local-first apps for Linux.

text.tspan: forging 11 apps across work, play & Linux…
